title: [GrantFox] Add retry backoff to Horizon polling
body:
### Summary
Horizon polling has no backoff on 429s.

### Background
See Horizon rate limit docs.

### Proposed scope
**In scope**: exponential backoff in stellar-kit poller
**Out of scope**: switching away from polling

### Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Poller retries with exponential backoff on HTTP 429

### Tests required
- packages/stellar-kit/test/poller.test.ts

### Docs required
None required

### Security and Stellar correctness notes
No secret key handling.

### Estimate
small
